tagline: Track books and who has them
summary: A single list of books with title, author, and type; mark a book lent by entering a borrower's name and clear it on return; filter to what's out and see how many.

journeys.title: Add a book
journeys.steps: Open app; click add; enter title, author, type; save; see it in the list with no badge

journeys.title: Reject empty title
journeys.steps: Click add; leave title blank; save
journeys.expect: Title is required message shown; record not saved

journeys.title: Edit a book
journeys.steps: Click a book; edit title or author or type; save

journeys.title: Lend a book
journeys.steps: Click a book with no borrower; choose Lend; enter borrower name; save
journeys.expect: Badge shows Out: borrower; Lent out stat increments

journeys.title: Return a book
journeys.steps: Click a book with a borrower; choose Return
journeys.expect: Borrower cleared; badge gone; Lent out stat decrements

journeys.title: Filter to what's out
journeys.expect: Only books with a borrower shown

journeys.title: Filter to what's home
journeys.expect: Only books with no borrower shown

journeys.title: See how many are lent out
journeys.expect: Count of books with a borrower shown

journeys.title: Refresh persists data
journeys.expect: All books, borrowers, and filters unchanged

omitted_patterns.reason: Stated as just me on my own computer
Only current borrower noted, cleared on return

omitted_patterns.pattern: Book cover images or ISBN lookup

assumptions: Type options are Novel, Cookbook, and Reference as representative examples
Lend action prompts for a borrower name rather than using a select
A Home filter is implied alongside the Out filter
implemented_features: Single list of books with title, author, type
Lend and return actions setting and clearing borrower
Out and Home state filters on borrower
Lent out stat counting books with a borrower
